assets.theme: Flat Lay T Shirt Chest Measurement Guide with Copy Space
assets.palette: chalk white, slate blue, muted rust, charcoal
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create an apparel measurement illustration for a product size chart and a customer support guide. Leave room for the designer to add localized instructions and sizing values.
Subject and Material: Show one generic short sleeve cotton T shirt laid completely flat, with the sleeves relaxed and the side seams straight. Draw one fine rust colored horizontal measurement line from one underarm seam junction to the opposite underarm seam junction. End the line exactly at the junctions with small clear ticks.
Composition: Use a horizontal 16:9 canvas. Keep the shirt entirely in the left half on a pale chalk surface. Leave the right 43 percent consistently pale and clear, with generous outer margins.
Art Direction: Use precise apparel editorial linework with subtle matte knit texture and simple seam construction.
Lighting and Mood: Use even diffuse light with minimal shadow.
Constraints: Output clean 4K artwork without text, measurements, logos, brand details, additional arrows, props or watermarks.
assets.negative_prompt: body measurement, tape measure with numerals, chest circumference, diagonal arrow, missing underarm seams, text, labels

assets.theme: Indigo Denim Flat Felled Seam with Quiet Copy Space
assets.palette: washed indigo, deep navy, warm ochre, soft blue
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create a textile background for apparel material pages and denim collection brochures. Reserve a calm field for material specifications or a short headline.
Subject and Material: Depict one continuous indigo cotton denim surface with a single flat felled seam. Show a low folded ridge and two restrained parallel rows of ochre topstitching. Render a consistent diagonal twill with subtle variation in the yarn and believable tension near the stitches.
Composition: Use a horizontal 16:9 macro crop viewed square to the fabric. Run the seam close to the right quarter of the canvas. Keep the left 56 percent flat, evenly colored and low contrast while allowing the weave to remain visible.
Art Direction: Use restrained textile macro illustration with clean stitch geometry and fine tactile detail.
Lighting and Mood: Apply broad raking daylight from the upper right with shallow, soft relief.
Constraints: Deliver 4K without pockets, rivets, labels, text, logos, watermarks or claims of seamless tiling.
assets.negative_prompt: back pocket, belt loops, denim brand patch, torn hole, frayed rip, crossing seams, oversharpened weave, repeating tile

assets.theme: Knitwear Pilling Detail for Garment Condition Guides
assets.palette: warm oatmeal, muted pebble, soft ivory, taupe
assets.prompt:
Purpose: Create an educational portrait background for knitwear care articles and secondhand seller training. The designer will add their own explanatory text.
Subject and Material: Show the ribbed cuff of one plain oatmeal knit sleeve with a small realistic cluster of pills attached to the yarn near the cuff edge. Keep the adjoining knitting intact and let the cuff ribs curve naturally along a single loose fold.
Composition: Use a 9:16 vertical canvas. Place the cuff in the lower third, fully inside the side margins, with the pilled area legible at mobile size. Leave the upper half and top margin clear on a continuous warm ivory surface.
Art Direction: Use tactile macro editorial illustration with accurately shaped knit loops, fine fuzz and restrained color.
Lighting and Mood: Use diffuse side light with soft shadows and a quiet instructional mood.
Constraints: Deliver 4K with no hands, labels, lettering, magnifier graphics, brand marks or watermarks.
assets.negative_prompt: fabric holes, stains, dust scatter, floating fuzz, heavy distress, before and after split, brand label, actual listing photo
